items.description: Button paddingY matches shadcn (8px vertical padding). Currently 0px in shadcss per gaps.csv.
steps: Read packages/shadcss/src/components/button.css
Identify the padding declaration on the .btn selector
Add or adjust vertical padding to 8px (0.5rem) to match shadcn canon
Run npm run build to rebuild dist
Run bash scripts/check.sh to verify all gates pass and fidelity comparator shows one fewer deviation
items.regression_notes: Ensure button height/line-height doesn't break existing showcase layout in apps/www/index.html. Check that button variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) all inherit the padding correctly. Verify the fidelity comparator real_deviations count decreases by 1.

items.description: Progress background uses primary color directly instead of mix:primary. shadcn uses primary for the track background.
steps: Read packages/shadcss/src/components/progress.css
Identify the background declaration on the .progress selector
Change from color-mix primary to direct primary to match shadcn canon
Run npm run build to rebuild dist
Run bash scripts/check.sh to verify all gates pass and fidelity comparator shows 0 real deviations
items.regression_notes: Ensure the progress bar still renders correctly in both light and dark modes. Check that the progress-indicator (inner bar) contrast against the track remains sufficient. Verify showcase progress examples still look right. Verify the fidelity comparator real_deviations count reaches 0.

items.description: Audit notification components (sonner, toast, alert) against shadcn spec for missing styles, variants, or slots. Ensure CSS-only fidelity for all notification patterns.
steps: Read qa/fidelity/shadcn-spec.json entries for sonner, toast, and alert
Compare each against the corresponding shadcss source CSS (sonner.css, toast.css, alert.css)
Check for missing: variants, color tokens, spacing, border-radius, shadow, animation timing
Fix any discrepancies found in the source CSS
Run npm run build && bash scripts/check.sh to verify
items.regression_notes: Ensure toast/sonner animations still work. Verify alert variants (default, info, success, warning, destructive) still render correctly. Check that the showcase notification examples still look right.

items.description: Improve the fidelity comparator (scripts/fidelity/compare.mjs) to handle shadcss's alternative slot naming patterns, reducing the 99 'not comparable' slots to only genuinely missing ones.
steps: Read scripts/fidelity/compare.mjs and understand the MAP and compareSlot function
Read qa/fidelity/gaps.csv and identify the 'not found' slots that are actually present but named differently (e.g. shadcn uses 'dropdown-menu-content' but shadcss uses 'dropdown-menu')
Add alias mappings or selector patterns to the comparator for these slots
Re-run the comparator and verify the 'not comparable' count drops significantly
Run bash scripts/check.sh to verify all gates still pass
items.regression_notes: Ensure the comparator still correctly identifies real deviations. Do not suppress genuine gaps by over-mapping. Verify the real_deviations count doesn't change (should still be whatever it was before this item).

items.description: Once all fidelity deviations are resolved (real_deviations=0), update scripts/check.sh to make the fidelity comparator a hard gate that fails on any real deviation. This ensures the loop catches regressions.
steps: Verify that node scripts/fidelity/compare.mjs reports real_deviations=0
Edit scripts/check.sh: change the fidelity WARNING block to exit 1 if REAL_DEVIATIONS > 0
Run bash scripts/check.sh to verify it still passes (ALL GATES PASS)
Commit the change
items.regression_notes: This item is blocked until all fix-* and audit-* items pass. Ensure the hard gate doesn't break on comparator parsing edge cases. Verify that the gate still passes after the change.
